data.title: 橘美花莉 · 巧克力盒上的蝴蝶结
data.description: 美花莉穿灰粉针织衫和象牙白半围裙坐在餐桌前，用细缎带给巧克力盒打结。栗棕色的长发在两侧各扎着小蝴蝶结垂在胸前。她发现缎带两边长短不一，抿起嘴唇拆开重来；桌上散落的备选小盒见证了这份专一的深情。
data.action: 拆开不对称的蝴蝶结，认真重新系好，粉眸专注
data.promptProse: Mikari Tachibana sits at the dining table tying fine satin ribbon around the chocolate box, then purses her lips and starts again when the ends are uneven. Her dusty-rose knit sleeves and ivory waist apron remain tidy, with small side bows holding her chestnut hair forward. Spare boxes lie beside her working hands in the medium portrait. The far table edge meets a chair back, and a low dining cabinet continues toward the window behind her. Soft afternoon light reveals ribbon sheen and knit texture; each box casts a small distinct shadow, while the cabinet face becomes dimmer away from the window.
